leadership.subtitle: Managing Director Statement
leadership.authorCompany: Reva Calibration Laboratories (Div. of Reva Phoenix)
quotes: For over two decades, Reva Calibration Laboratories has stood as an authoritative cornerstone for precision measurement across India and global supply chains. What began as a dedicated calibration initiative has grown into India largest integrated NABL-accredited metrology complex housing 35 specialized laboratories under a single roof.

Precision is not just a measurement it is the foundation of industrial safety, aerospace integrity, and engineering competitiveness. With state-of-the-art environmental controls at 20°C ± 1°C, laser interferometry, deadweight testers up to 4000 Bar, and high-precision calibrators, we deliver measurement uncertainties that set industry benchmarks.

Our dual commitment to permanent laboratory excellence and rapid on-site calibration guarantees that your critical gauges, sensors, and machine tools maintain unbroken international traceability. In metrology, there is no margin for error: Quality is our way of life!

about.subtitle: Corporate Message & Leadership Commitment
about.titlePart1: Quality Is Our Way Of Life!
about.paragraph1: Reva Phoenix Labs & Consultants Pvt. Ltd., with its 35+ Accredited Calibration Laboratories with an extensive Scope by NABL for ISO/IEC 17025: 2017, makes us one of the Largest – Integrated – Calibration Laboratories in India! With all modesty, that is an incredible achievement for our Laboratory in our scale of business, across India and the Middle East.
about.paragraph2: It is the endeavor of Reva Phoenix Labs & Consultants Pvt. Ltd. to provide ethical, independent, value-added Calibration to our Customers. Our unwavering focus to the 3P’s: Precision, Perfection and Professionalism coupled with learning and advancement of our knowledge, sharing them with our customers, and the value addition that we make to our clients, have made Reva Phoenix a trusted name in the field of Calibration in India & Middle East.
about.paragraph3: In our ever-changing and challenging world of business, we are committed to keeping our Organization, Laboratory, Engineers, Equipment and facility in a leadership position. We value and focus on Quality measures as a commitment to Integrity and Quality.
